title: District 11 Drift Gillnet Fishery Area Extension Into Speel Arm Terminal Harvest Area (Tha)
full_text:
Forrest Bowers, Acting Director

Doug Vincent-Lang, Commissioner

Juneau Area Office Juneau, AK 99811

Advisory Announcement For Immediate Release: August 22, 2026

Juneau, AK 99811-5526

CONTACT: Scott Forbes Juneau Area Management Biologist scott.forbes@alaska.gov (907) 465-4250

DISTRICT 11 DRIFT GILLNET FISHERY AREA EXTENSION INTO SPEEL ARM TERMINAL HARVEST AREA (THA)

Section 11-B: the Speel Arm THA will be open from 12:01 p.m., Sunday, August 23, through 12:00 noon, Wednesday, August 26, 2026, with the following restrictions:

Gilbert Bay: will be closed south and east of a line from Sentinel Point at 57°59.74′ N lat, 133°45.65′ W long to a point on the eastern shoreline at 58°01.45′ N lat, 133°45.33′ W long;

Speel Arm: will be closed north of a line from a point on the western shore at the head of Speel Arm at 58°07.09′ N lat, 133°44.11′ W long to a point on the eastern shore at 58°07.59′ N lat, 133°42.80′ W long;

Prospect Creek: will be closed west of a line running southeast from Prospect Point at 58°02.89′ N lat, 133°47.80′ W long to the southernmost tip of Fannie Island at 58°02.60′ N lat, 133°47.15′ W long then running southwest to a point on the western shore at 58°01.34′ N lat, 133°48.46′ W long.

The Emergency Order corresponding with this announcement is EO 1S6526.

Advisory Announcement web site: http://www.adfg.alaska.gov/index.cfm?adfg=cfnews.main.
